notes.title: Update - 1.0.5
notes.notes:
[h3]New Feature[/h3]
[b]Auto-aim[/b]
[list]
[*] New functionality: by pressing the "R" key, the game will automatically aim and shoot at the nearest enemy, making combat easier in intense situations.
[/list]
[h3]Balancing[/h3]
[b]Weapon adjustments[/b]
[list]
[*] Revised stats for all weapons to keep their DPS as close as possible to each other, ensuring variety in gameplay and balance between options.
[*] Skill explosions: Explosion damage has been reduced to half of the skill hit damage, preventing them from being overly powerful.
[/list]
[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[b]Drop system[/b]
[list]
[*] Small mana: Reduced the drop rate of small mana to balance resource economy.
[*] Purchase capacity: Increased the ability to purchase drop percentage upgrades, allowing players to customize their resource-gathering experience.
[/list]
[b]Monster spawns[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved monster spawn locations for a smoother and fairer gameplay experience.
[/list]
[b]Infinite mana[/b]
[list]
[*] Now, when picking up an infinite mana drop, the player immediately receives maximum mana, avoiding scenarios where skills cannot be used even with the drop active.
[/list]
[b]Mana range upgrade
[/b]
[list]
[*] Reduced the distance at which the mana range upgrade works, making it more strategic and balanced.
[/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]
Minor general fixes to improve stability and gameplay experience.
